Diageo CEO Unveils Turnaround Plan with Production Boost and Job Cuts

Diageo's new CEO, Dave Lewis, has announced a strategic overhaul aimed at doubling Guinness production. The plan also involves cutting a significant portion of the company's 30,000-strong workforce. Lewis's proposals have reportedly lifted investor spirits, with the CEO earning the nickname 'Drastic Dave' for his decisive approach. Despite the production increase, the company anticipates flat growth in the short term.
